title: The third condition of Salah – proper clothing
intro: We wear clean, decent clothes – especially when we stand before Allah.

learn.html: With clothes we protect our body and our modesty. Allah revealed: O children of Adam, We have given you clothing to cover yourselves. So we always wear decent clothes – beautiful, clean and tidy.
We never wear short, tight or see-through clothes. In Salah especially we must dress properly, because we stand before our Lord.

learn.title: Covering in Salah
learn.html: Girls and women cover the whole body except the face, hands and feet. Boys and men dress decently – at the very least covering from the waist to below the knees.

learn.title: 📖 In the Qur’an
learn.html: O children of Adam, take your adornment (dress nicely) when you come to pray. <small>(Qur’an, Al-A‘raf 7:31)</small>

practice.title: Clothes for Salah
practice.prompt: Should our clothes for Salah be like this?
